_head: Phase 1's measurements, replayable. Boxes are design pt at 3 capture px to the pt; run with --pt 3. `img` is assets/refs/cN.png, the Nth Mobbin capture converted from the untagged Display P3 it exported in to sRGB (scratch/srgb.py) -- reading a colour off the raw pN.png puts every hue about 8% out. --against wants scratch/shot, which scratch/win.py fills with the seven boards rendered at 3x with --crop-phone; every probe names its own file there.
